prisoners.name: Louis Rodemann
prisoners.description:
Louis Rodemann is an activist documented in Nuclear Resister’s reporting on protest arrests.

On 2026-04-27, Louis Rodemann was arrested at Kansas City National Security Campus. Cited for municipal trespass and released at the plant, without offsite booking. Nuclear Resister #208 reports that defendants appearing June 4 learned prosecutors had not filed the case; the report does not individually identify that first arraignment group.
prisoners.body: Verified detail sources (October 9, 2026, continued review): United for Peace and Justice explicitly includes Louis Rodemann among five men participating in the Kansas City nuclear-plant protest. The Lasallian community’s biographical profile independently identifies the Kansas City Christian Brother with he/him. Reported age is not converted into a birthdate; citation arrest is not treated as a prison term. Source 1. Source 2.
